title: Looking for a action movie where the main character is living a normal life but he has a past and in the present something makes him bring that animal back (like John wick, Nobody (2021), the equalizer)

You might want to check out 'A History of Violence' by David Cronenberg. It's a film from 2005 that follows Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen), a regular guy whose life gets turned upside down when he becomes a local hero after stopping a robbery. Idon't want to give spoilers, but I believe it's exactly what you're asking for.
